Figure 02 | Class Diagram — Partnership CRM Data Model

ESSM Industry Categories (10): Energy, Materials & Industrials; Health Care; Financial (Bank & Insurance); Tech Company; FMCG & FnB; Communication Services; E-Commerce and Retail; Education; Consulting; Others.
Project Support is maintained separately: oGX; iGV; Membership; LV; AFL; Brand Activation; BD Project; LC Initiatives; Others.

Rate Card & Pricing Catalog
RateCardItem stores the benefit category, benefit name, unit and monetized unit value. RateCardPackage and RateCardPackageBenefit define package tiers and included quantities. ProposalBenefit records selected benefits, agreed unit values and contribution type; line totals and proposal totals are calculated from the selected pricing mode. Each package benefit is included once in the proposal total.
ESSM Rate Card assessments retain the Monetize Quality factors (Retention Rate, Event Size, Scale of Event, Quality of Partnership, Duration of Partnership) and Monetize Value factors (SDGs Alignment, Leadership Value Alignment, Partnership Retained, Historical Score, Communication). Calculation rules and currency/unit settings are maintained centrally. Initial editable package templates: Community (Rp500.000), Brand (Rp1.500.000), Engagement (Rp3.000.000) and Impact (Rp6.000.000).

Controlled values
AccessRole {CRM_LEAD, BD_STAFF, VIEWER}; TL BD and LCVP PD share CRM_LEAD permissions, with organizational title stored separately. SalesType {NEW, RE_RAISE}; SalesStatus {ACTIVE, INACTIVE}; ApproachMethod {ACTIVE, PASSIVE}; PartnershipStatus {ACTIVE, BREAK, FINISH}; ReRaiseDecision {YES, NO, PLANNING_TO}; ESSMStage {PROSPECTING, SALES_PROCESS, CLOSE_DEAL, PARTNERSHIP_IMPLEMENTATION, POST_SURVEY}; InKindType {ADDED_VALUE, COST_REDUCTION}; SurveyStatus {NOT_SENT, SENT, COMPLETION_CONFIRMED}; RevenueType {FINANCIAL, IN_KIND}; PricingMode {PACKAGE, CUSTOM, HYBRID}.

Business rules
1) A Partner can have multiple PartnershipCycle records; Re-Raise creates a new cycle while preserving partner history. 2) MarketResearch stores PIC-verified Values, Vision, Current Focus and Program scores (each 1–5), supporting evidence and the Proceed decision; the AI fit score is stored separately. 3) Rate Card package benefits are stored as structured proposal lines; calculated totals follow the selected pricing mode. 4) RevenueRecord captures actual financial/in-kind contributions by partner, program, date/month, value and evidence; proposal values remain forecasts until receipts are recorded. 5) MerchandiseRealization stores item or bundle sales and calculates cost, revenue and profit from realized quantities; merchandise sales are tracked separately from partner revenue. 6) Survey records store the official form URL and dispatch/completion status. 7) A newsletter is required monthly during an active partnership; the realization report is required when an event/program finishes; partner visits, AIESEC event invitations and greeting cards are optional. 8) TL BD and LCVP PD share CRM Lead permissions. LoA approval requires a different user from the submitter, and sensitive actions are audit-logged.

Association multiplicity
1 = exactly one    0..1 = optional    * = many    0..* = zero or many

Table accounting: 30 core domain classes + 3 persistence/support tables + 1 technical schema_migrations table = 34 PostgreSQL tables. schema_migrations is generated by the migration runner and is not a business entity.

Partner Engagement activities take place during active implementation. Monthly newsletters and program realization reports are mandatory; partner visits, event invitations and greeting cards are optional. Revenue records reflect actual receipts. Merchandise transactions are tracked separately. CRM stores the national survey URL and dispatch/completion status.
